theoretical_engineering_analysis.mono_vs_multichannel: A single microphone capture scalar pressure p(t) carries omnidirectional energy with zero spatial phase information. Localization in 2D or 3D is mathematically underdetermined from a single static observation.

tdoa_mathematical_formulation.formula: R_ij^PHAT(tau) = Integral [ (X_i(f) * X_j*(f)) / |X_i(f) * X_j*(f)| * exp(j*2*pi*f*tau) ] df

minimum_microphones_required.3d_range_and_bearing: 4+ non-coplanar microphones with high SNR (>10 dB)

tdoa_mathematical_formulation.array_baseline_distance: 15 cm to 25 cm (constrained by UAV motor arm spacing)

drone_rotor_noise_interference.rotor_harmonics: Harmonic series up to 2.5 kHz overlapping Bengali vocal formants (F1, F2: 300-2200 Hz)
drone_rotor_noise_interference.required_mitigation: Adaptive MVDR (Minimum Variance Distortionless Response) spatial filtering with fixed notch filters on rotor harmonics

environmental_reverberation.adverse_weather_effects: Dense fog causes acoustic attenuation at high frequencies (>4 kHz). Heavy rain droplet impact creates random impulsive wideband noise. Dense tree canopies in disaster zones introduce multipath reverberation (RT60 > 0.4s) that broadens GCC-PHAT correlation peaks, increasing angular error.

operational_rescue_integration.current_capability: Omnidirectional Acoustic Trigger: Distress vocalization triggers UAV to suspend transit and initiate localized optical spiral search.

future_hardware_roadmap.phase_1_sensor: 4-channel MEMS microphone array (I2S interface) mounted on vibration-isolated dampeners below drone fuselage.
future_hardware_roadmap.phase_2_dsp: On-chip FPGA or microcontroller executing real-time GCC-PHAT and Steered Response Power (SRP-PHAT).
future_hardware_roadmap.phase_3_guidance: Autonomous flight controller orienting gimbal/camera directly along estimated acoustic bearing (+/- 12 degrees).
